constructed by Barry Hirsch (Andrew Young School of Policy Studies, Georgia State University), David Macpherson (Department of Economics, Trinity University), and William Even (Department of Economics, Miami University),was created in 2002 and is updated annually.

atoms.reference: Private and public sector union membership, coverage and density estimates compiled from the monthly household Current Population Survey.

evidence.record_quote: is an Internet data resource providing private and public sector labor union membership, coverage, and density estimates compiled from the monthly household Current Population Survey (CPS) using BLS methods.

atoms.reference: Economy-wide estimates from 1973; by state, industry and occupation from 1983; by metropolitan area from 1986; the 2025 compilation completed 23 January 2026.

evidence.record_quote: Economy-wide estimates are provided beginning in 1973; estimates by state, detailed industry, and detailed occupation begin in 1983; and estimates by metropolitan area begin in 1986.
Union data compilations from the 2025 CPS completed January 23, 2026.
